about: Release calendar for every source on the softs desk. Read by pipelines/watchdog.py (desk catch-up job and the source repos' own catch-up jobs). Times are US Eastern. 'release' rules are explained in pipelines/release_rules.py. 'late_after_hours': how long after the release the data may still be missing before it counts as late; rules of type 'age' use the data-status limit instead. 'manual': the source needs an upload or entry by Ma, so the catch-up job reports it but never reruns anything for it. 'workflow': the GitHub Actions workflow that collects it (its repo's catch-up job reruns it). 'season' {from, to} (MM-DD, may wrap the year end): outside it the report is 'off season' and never late; null = all year. An optional season.last_report (YYYY-MM-DD) ends the season early for that year.
